answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must lock a jade token reserve and commit to cryptographic stake burning for identity registration. Under a willow verification tree, creating n identities imposes a superlinear cost scaling as O(n^2), forcing each registration to destroy non-refundable collateral. Any slashable misbehavior triggers a ripple effect that burns bonded collateral across clustered identities, imposing exponential economic friction.
